Name: Feeling Lucky?
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Are ya feeling lucky, punk?  Adds luck buffs to some clothing items (currently only the Leprechaun Shoes)
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT MODDROP OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the two sites listed above and no where else.

Based on this request (https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/456) by Trent!  Adds a luck buff to the Leprechaun Shoes, with plans to expand the buff to other types of clothing in the future.  Feel free to suggest items to be added, but try to have a reason why one should be added :smile:

Install
Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Download this mod and unzip it.
Copy the 'FeelingLucky' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
